title: Say Boses manlapud Manpopoolan a Kiew
intro: Amtaen so pakabidbiran na sakey a matalonggaring a too ya say biahe to et ginmapo ed sakey a mamilagron impitongtong tan say kapalaran to et nankakasakey ed kibulos na sakey a totoon napapairap. Sayan indibidual so pinili parad baleg a kimey, ya aarapen to so angkakabaleg iran angat tekep na madibinon suporta.
clues: Nianak ak ed panaon na mapalalo a panagpairap, a papateyen iray ugugaw a totook.
Say inmunan bilay ko et say impangiyan ed siak na ateng ko ed sakey ya ilog, balet ta siak so aromog tan binmaleg ed mismon sankaabungan na managpairap na totook.
Aminsan et binmatik ak ed sakey a syudad kayari na agko ginagala ya sengegan na impatey na sakey ya indibidual legan na panlalaban.
Akaawat ak na madibinon mensahe tan sakey a mamilagron baston diad sakey a sagradon pasen, a ditan et niganggan ak a miarap ed sakey a makapanyarin manuley.
Say agik ko so tinuro bilang katulongan ko ed misyon ko, lapud walay naimano ton makaamper ed panagsalitak.
Inwanwan ko ray totook ed biek na dayat, ya akaliktar ak ed panguusil na sakey a maruksan armada.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Mansungdo ed dakel a taon na kelang
Say pangikompronta ed si Faraon tan saray managsalamangka to
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang a hurnoan
Say inkaderal na totoo ed Thamud
trial.answer: Say pangikompronta ed si Faraon tan saray managsalamangka to

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say syudad na Sodoma so atumba
Saray totoo et inakmon na dalin
Say baleg a delap so angitarok ed dalin
Nalner so Faraon tan saray sundalo to
Ageba iray padir na syudad lapud sakey ya akis
outcome.answer: Nalner so Faraon tan saray sundalo to

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
